description: Annual country series for Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain: installed solar, wind and renewable capacity (IRENA, MW); solar and wind generation (TWh), their shares of electricity, demand in total and per person and the carbon intensity of electricity (Our World in Data); CO2 per person, population and renewable share of final energy (World Bank). Each metric carries its publisher, licence and unit; a year not reported is absent, never zero. Narrow by metric, country and years. The country layer of the Energy Atlas, free with membership: it answers a request carrying a member’s API key and refuses one without.
name: gcc_series
title: GCC country series
